pages.recipe:
照り焼きチキン

Teriyaki chicken

材料 · Serves 2

  • Chicken thigh2 pieces
  • Soy sauce2 tbsp
  • Mirin2 tbsp
  • Sake1 tbsp
  • Sugar1 tsp
  • Oil1 tsp

  1. Pat the thighs dry and prick the skin with a fork. This helps the sauce cling.

  2. Pan-fry skin-side down over medium heat for 6 minutes without moving, until deep golden.

  3. Flip, cover and cook 4 minutes. Wipe out the excess fat with kitchen paper.

  4. Add the sauce and let it reduce, spooning it over until glossy. Slice and serve over rice.

pages.basics:
Home/Basics

基本の基本

Two things to get right before anything else.

出汁

Dashi in 20 minutes

  1. Soak 10 g kombu in 1 litre water for 15 minutes.

  2. Heat gently; remove kombu just before boiling.

  3. Add 20 g katsuobushi, turn off, wait 2 minutes and strain.

ご飯

Rice, the Japanese way

  1. Rinse until the water is nearly clear.

  2. Soak 30 minutes. Use 1:1.1 rice to water.

  3. Cook, then rest covered for 10 minutes.

pages.faq:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

Can I use instant dashi?

Yes. Use half the amount first and taste.

Where can I buy mirin?

Most supermarkets. Look for hon-mirin, not "seasoning".

Is sake necessary?

It softens the smell of chicken. Water with a squeeze of lemon is a stand-in.
